upsertCronJobBy.description:
The timestamp before which a {@link CronJob} record must be persisted for the scheduled execution to begin.
This field is updated automatically after the entity is created or updated, and is filtered on and updated by
the managing CronJob

title:
Mixin for scheduling types where each record must start a new CronJob. This mixin prevents the CronScheduler from
being overwhelmed by a large number of Cron entries. It works by dynamically creating/removing CronJob entries
depending on the value of the {@link upsertCronJobBy} field.
name: ExMachinaDynamicCronJobScheduler
